still.caption:
At 03:17 UTC, Earth received a signal from deep space.

At first, scientists believed it was coming from an unknown object beyond the Moon.

They were wrong.

The object was not beyond the Moon.

The Moon was in front of it.

Whatever produced the signal was so large that our instruments could not determine where it ended.

For seventeen seconds, it remained perfectly still.

Then one part of its surface opened.

Something inside was looking directly at Earth.

The transmission ended immediately.

The observation did not.

episodes.title: THE EYE BEHIND THE MOON

reel.caption:
The Moon moved.

At first, we thought the darkness behind it was empty space.

Then it opened its eye.

And looked directly at Earth.
